description: This file contains implementation for the 'mbim' protocol in the network configuration system of OpenWrt. It includes functions to initialize configuration, set up and tear down network interfaces using the MBIM protocol, and handle interactions with the modem via the 'umbim' tool, including registration, PIN handling, and connection establishment.

methods.name: proto_mbim_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the MBIM protocol configuration, defining various configuration options such as device, APN, Pincode, IPv6, DHCP, MTU, etc.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_get_field
methods.description: Parses a given MBIM configuration string to extract the value for a specified field.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Performs the core setup process for an MBIM interface, including device validation, modem initialization, PIN handling, network registration, connection, and IP configuration.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Wrapper around _proto_mbim_setup that retries after failure.

methods.name: proto_mbim_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the MBIM network connection and cleans up state.
